edit: `last k` starts one stream late (k - 1 streams)
note: changes only specifications that use a window (L1's); M2, B3 and M3 have none, so those three are unchanged by it

name: a dropped cluster
edit: the last stream is never drawn into any resample

name: a wrong pairing

name: a wrong percentile
